question:
Study the given pie chart carefully and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ad08af71116fb0f52e423849579d7d8a4c71b5a957f6da6e99ca0e0bafc007.png] 

The given pie chart represents the data of Amit's followers on various social networking sites.

If Amit has 40 crore followers in all the networking sites combined, then the number of his followers on Facebook will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Amit has 40 crore followers in all the networking sites combined

**Calculation:**

Number of Amit's followers on Facebook = 32/100 × 40 crores

= 32/5 × 2 crores

= 64/5 crores

= 12.8 crores
